plugin.name: LibraryMapper
plugin.creator: Chris / NSP-0123456
plugin.desc: Map your large music library inside Lyrion: browse a virtual Genre\Artist\Year-Album layout with temporal (albums added recently) and quality (hi-res/CD/lossy) filters, simplify hundreds of raw genre tags into a few broad groups, and consolidate album artist spelling variants - all without touching a single file on disk. Includes an initialization phase, mapping validation and download/upload of mapping files from the plugin parameter page.
plugin.title: LibraryMapper
